name: FHA / VA Loan Timeline
summary: Government-backed financing, with the stricter appraisal and repair rules.

milestones.name: Offer Accepted
milestones.buyerNote: The seller has signed. FHA and VA loans take a little longer because the appraisal is stricter, so we have built that in.
milestones.waitingOn: Nothing — sit tight, we will tell you when we need you

milestones.name: Earnest Money Deposit
milestones.buyerNote: Your good-faith deposit goes to the escrow company. It is credited back to you at closing.
milestones.waitingOn: You — wire the deposit to escrow

milestones.name: Home Inspection
milestones.buyerNote: An inspector spends two or three hours walking the home and sends a written report. You are welcome to come along.

milestones.name: Inspection Response
milestones.buyerNote: We decide together what to ask the seller for — repairs, a credit, or nothing — and send it over.
milestones.waitingOn: The seller's answer to our request

milestones.name: FHA / VA Appraisal
milestones.buyerNote: This appraisal does two jobs: confirms the value, and checks the home meets minimum property standards. It is stricter than a conventional one.

milestones.name: Required Repairs
milestones.buyerNote: If the appraiser flagged anything — peeling paint, handrails, a roof issue — it has to be fixed before the loan can fund.

milestones.name: Title Search
milestones.buyerNote: The title company checks that the seller can legally sell and that no old debts are attached to the property.

milestones.name: Loan Approval
milestones.buyerNote: Underwriting signs off on your file. Avoid new credit cards, big purchases, or job changes until this clears.

milestones.name: Final Walkthrough
milestones.buyerNote: We walk the home one last time to confirm the required repairs were done and nothing else has changed.

milestones.name: Closing Day
milestones.buyerNote: You sign, the funds move, and the keys are yours. Bring photo ID.
